text: Elijah has his promotion panel on 14 May. Remind me to text him good luck the night before.
yasmin's last day at the agency is friday, leaving drinks at the Crown after work
Chat w Alejandro after standup. His wife Petra is due in about six weeks, he's already shattered just thinking about it. Get a card from the team before he goes on paternity leave.

Freya said the client pitch for Banerjee & Co got moved to 3rd of June. She's presenting solo for the first time and is properly nervous. I should check in with her the day before and maybe do a dry run with her on the Monday.
Ava - allergic to sesame, don't order the poke place for the team lunch

okay so just got off the phone with Aoife, she's moving to Galway at the end of the month, flat's all sorted, her boyfriend Leon is going over first to start the new job. Need to send her the box of books I borrowed before she goes.
Yusuf ran the Bristol half on Sunday. ask him how it went tmrw
Note to self: dentist Thursday 9:15, then pick up dry cleaning
Nia's dad has a hip op on 22/10. She's taking the week off to look after him. Remind me to message her that evening to see how it went.
Francesca (Fran) from accounts loves anything matcha, mentioned it twice today. Her birthday's next Wednesday so that's an easy gift.
Mabel's dog Biscuit had his op yesterday, all fine, he's wearing a cone and hating it
the offsite in Lisbon is off, budget got pulled. Esme was gutted
Alice and her husband are celebrating their tenth anniversary this weekend, going to Rome. Don't forget to send her a message on Saturday.
Rebecca Wright starts as head of client services on 1st November. Big deal for her. Congratulate her properly and invite her for lunch the week after she starts.
Chen called. His mum's in hospital again, chest infection, they think she'll be in till at least Tuesday. He sounded wiped out. Ring him on the weekend.
Kasia wants to come up and visit on the 8th and 9th of Nov, I'm doing the spare room this weekend
Xavier's performance review is tomorrow, he's dreading it, says his manager has been on his back for weeks. text him after
Met Julien for coffee. He's just finished his MBA, graduating 12 December, and his partner Anil is planning a surprise dinner for him the night after. I'm on dessert duty.

Ann's daughter got into Cambridge!! Ann was beaming, kept showing everyone the email. Her daughter wants to do medicine, starts in October next year, and Ann's already worrying about the cost of halls. Ann's husband is apparently planning a family dinner for it this Saturday. send flowers to the house before Saturday

Khadija said her sister Nadia is getting married in Lahore in March. Khadija's flying out on the 2nd and will be away three weeks. Need to sort cover for her accounts before then, and remind me to ask about the wedding when she's back.

Chantal mentioned she's been struggling since the restructure, her whole team got merged into Kemal's and nobody tells her anything. She said she's been sleeping badly and thinking about applying for the ops role in Manchester, but her partner doesn't want to move. Must take her for a proper coffee next week, not just a 5 min check in, and remind me to ask Kemal on Thursday whether there's room to give her back the supplier accounts.
Lila's band is playing the Lexington on 19 Nov. buy tix
Ximena is vegan and doesn't drink. Book the place on Hope Street for the client dinner, they do a decent menu.
Felix and his partner just bought a house in Leeds, completion date 30th, moving in the week after. Remind me to send a housewarming plant the day they get the keys.
Jin's cat Mochi went missing on Monday, still no sign. She's put posters up everywhere. I should share the post on the neighbourhood group tonight.
Ellie had her driving test today. Passed first time!
Kemal mentioned his son starts secondary school in September, he's more nervous than the kid is

voice memo: right so Hiroshi is leaving the Tokyo office and coming to London permanently, start date is the 6th of January, he's bringing his wife and their two kids. Um he asked if I knew any decent schools near Clapham. I said I'd ask around. Remind me to send him the list from Petra on Friday.
call w Elijah re the Thomas account. Client wants the deck by Thursday, Elijah's away Mon-Wed so I'm covering the review meeting. He also said his brother Sam is running the London marathon in April.
Yasmin's birthday 5/11. she's been eyeing up that ceramics course at the community centre, a voucher would go down well
Back from Petra and Alejandro's. Baby's sleeping through finally. Petra's mum is staying with them till mid November.
Mum's birthday dinner Saturday 7pm, I'm booking the table, need to pick up the cake Saturday morning
Remind me the day before Freya's pitch to send her the slides with my notes. And text her good luck that morning.
Ava had her interview with Kumar Partners on Tuesday. Waiting to hear back, they said by end of next week. Ask her Friday if she's heard anything.
Aoife's moving date got pushed to the 28th, Leon's already over there. she's coming to the leaving thing on the 21st though

Yusuf and Nia are engaged!!! Found out at lunch. Wedding probably next summer, maybe in Nia's home town in Cardiff, and Yusuf's already panicking about the speech. Nia's mum is apparently thrilled and has been planning since about 2019. Chip in for the card going round, and don't forget to ask Nia on Monday if they've picked a date yet.
quick one - Francesca's mum passed away on Sunday. funeral is Thursday 23rd. Fran's off for the rest of the week. sign the card and send something from the team.
Esme has her MRI on the 4th, she's trying to play it down but I can tell she's worried. message her the evening after
Need to renew the car insurance before 2nd Dec. Also book the MOT.
Alice got the promotion she went for in the spring. Team lead from January. Totally deserved.

Had a long catch up with Rebecca after the quarterly review. She's been at the firm eleven years, thinking she might go part time next year to look after her dad, he was diagnosed with Parkinson's in the summer. She hasn't decided yet. She also said her son Oliver has his grade 5 piano exam on 17 November and he's been practising every night. She lives in Didsbury now, moved in August. Remind me to ask how the exam went the week after.
Chen's back at work Monday after his mum's discharge. Pop by his desk and see how he's doing.
Kasia: coeliac. Proper strict, not just a preference. Remember for the 8th.
Xavier said the review went fine in the end, he's staying on the Ahmed project. He's still looking at other jobs though.
Julien and Anil are off to Japan for three weeks over Christmas, leaving the 20th. Julien's mad about ramen, wants recs for Osaka
Ann's retiring at the end of March after 30 years. The team's planning something for her last day, Khadija's organising. Ask Khadija on Monday what she needs from me.
Leon's starting at the hospital in Galway on Monday. ICU nurse. Text him Sunday night good luck
Chantal's birthday drinks were meant to be next Friday but she's called it off, too much going on. Maybe take her out for lunch instead the week after.
lila's cousin Marta is staying w her for a fortnight from tomorrow, so no flat parties lol
Ximena's flight back from Mexico City lands at 6am Tuesday. She's coming straight into the office for the board meeting, poor thing. Bring her a coffee.
Must remember to call Grandad on Sunday, it's his 90th next Saturday and we need to sort who's driving him to the party

Felix's little girl Rosie has her nativity play on the 15th, she's a sheep apparently. He's taking the afternoon off for it and his wife's parents are driving down from Durham the night before. Felix said he's been up till midnight helping make the costume out of an old fleece. Remind me to ask him on the 16th how it went and to get a photo, the team will love it.
Jin found Mochi!! She was in the neighbour's shed the whole time. Jin's over the moon
Ellie's starting at the design studio on 10th November, leaving us on the 7th. She's excited but a bit nervous about the commute. Remind me to message her at the end of her first week.
Kemal Khan from procurement — call him back Wednesday re the Andersson contract, he wants the revised figures by Friday

dictated: so I spoke to Hiroshi again this afternoon and the school thing is sorted, both kids got places at the one on Lavender Hill, they start after Easter. His wife Yuki is still in Tokyo packing up and flying over on the 3rd of February. He seemed a lot more relaxed. Note that he mentioned he's really into cycling, wants to do the London to Brighton ride next year. Maybe lend him my spare bike in spring.
Freya's pitch went really well! Client signed on the spot. Buy her a drink Friday.
Petra's brother Tomasz is over from Krakow next weekend, they're doing a big family lunch on Sunday. Alejandro asked if we wanted to come — I said yes, I'm bringing the pierogi from the deli.
Elijah didn't get the promotion. He was pretty flat about it. Take him for a pint next week, don't make a thing of it.
Gym, laundry, finish the expenses report. Nothing else today.
